notes.title: Cartels 0.0.29.0 Patch
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]

- Added steam launch param "inputdebug"
- Bullets now have travel time and drop, bullet tracers
- Added bots. Use the "addbots" command as an admin to spawn them
- Added new character variants for cartel + coalition
- Fixed some issues with Trench
- Fixed not being able to enter the corner of the Jungle A building
- Fixed many cursor locking issues
- Updated Jungle
- Fixed grenades not doing damage
- A spawn timer is now shown in the loadout editor
- The UI update is triggered now when spotting
- Increased machine gun ADS speeds by about 20%
- Updated animator transitions in first person
- Added fall damage
- Added damage tagging (slowed movement after being hit)
- Fixed gun holster and draw timings being out of sync with the animations
- Updated muzzle flashes for most guns
- Subsonic weapons no longer produce a crack when suppressing an enemy
- Optimized some third person animator parameters
